description: This file is a C++ source code for a QUIC protocol interoperability test client, which performs various connection and protocol feature tests with a server, including version negotiation, handshake, stream data exchange, key updates, and HTTP/3 support. It constructs and sends HTTP/2 headers, manages connection features, and reports supported features based on server responses.

classes.name: QuicClientInteropRunner
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of QUIC protocol feature tests, including attempting connections, resumption, key updates, and HTTP requests, while tracking supported features.

methods.name: AttemptResumption
methods.description: Attempts to resume a session with the server and records if resumption and 0-RTT data are supported.

methods.name: AttemptRequest
methods.description: Performs a full connection and request cycle with various protocol features, including version negotiation, handshake, key updates, port rebinding, and HTTP/3 support.

methods.name: ConstructHeaderBlock
methods.description: Constructs HTTP/2 headers for a GET request to the specified authority.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using the client and records features based on the response.
